PagBiografia.subtitulo: This is the story of our group
PagBiografia.texto1: Leizeak was formed a few years ago as a project between three friends: Siobhan, Irati and Irantzu, who were keen to make some noise and tell their own stories.
PagBiografia.texto2: Since then, we’ve gone through various line-up changes, experimenting with sounds and styles, and sharing the stage with different people who have left their mark along the way.
PagBiografia.texto3: We are now established as a trio consisting of guitar, bass and drums. This is how we feel we have found a clearer and more direct identity.
PagBiografia.texto4: Through our songs, we try to share a little of who we are and what we experience, and every concert is an opportunity for us to share special moments and enjoy ourselves with you.
PagBiografia.texto5: We hope that you too will enjoy this project and feel a sense of ownership towards it.
